control: stock ggml-cuda NORM, MUL, and ADD kernels
intervention: fused F32 NORM -> broadcast MUL -> broadcast ADD kernel using the existing RMS fusion layout checks
workload: English Q8_0 jfk.wav streaming, 80 ms feeds, R=1

hypotheses.H1: graph-disabled computational/memory fusion reduces frequency-weighted kernel time across every material production shape
hypotheses.H2: one node/dispatch instead of three improves graph-enabled complete served latency

primary_metric: ABBA-blocked complete graph-enabled served request mean

promotion.schedule: ABBA blocks with stock and candidate binaries interleaved

numerical_gate: fused GPU affine-LN output agrees with unfused CPU output for both production shapes at max_abs_error <= 1e-4 and max_rel_error <= 1e-4; internal bit identity is not required
correctness_gate: exact hyp_text and token_ids_csv match stock on jfk.wav, dots.wav, and noise.wav

decision_ladder.PROMOTE: >=5% served mean win on one target, same-direction p95, no >2% regression on the other, quality passes
decision_ladder.QUALIFY: repeatable 2-5% served win on both, or >=5% on one architecture with a justified architecture-specific gate
decision_ladder.HOLD: substantial graph-disabled shape win without a served-request win
decision_ladder.KILL: material shape regression, >2% served regression, or numerical/quality failure

kill_condition: numerical/quality mismatch, material production-shape regression, or >2% served regression on either target
resource_gate: no persistent allocation; isolated physical GPU; graph-enabled served validation
evidence_class_goal: C then R across the second target
